raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "r-elpigraph.r" %}
{% set version = "1.0.0" %}
{% set sha256 = "1a3e77de2b8c5e642c31ca8c9807007ad19fbd1dfd3d699eb97e700211df5385" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/Albluca/ElPiGraph.R/archive/251415810d1cf2a973eaa51d0f8e520e14dbe1cb.zip
  #url: https://github.com/simplejson/{{ name }}/archive/{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: {{ sha256 }}

build:
  number: 1007
  # r-distutils is not available on win
  skip: true  # [win]
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-distutils
    - r-tictoc
    - r-irlba
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-ggforce
    - r-segmented
    - r-ggpubr
    - r-infotheo
    - r-gensa
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-distutils
    - r-tictoc
    - r-irlba
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-ggforce
    - r-segmented
    - r-ggpubr
    - r-infotheo
    - r-gensa

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('ElPiGraph.R')"  # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('ElPiGraph.R')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/Albluca/ElPiGraph.R
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_family: GPL
  summary: An R package to construct Elastic Principal Graphs
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - lucapinello
